title: In a part lookup an untracked part keeps its bin chips beside Not Tracked
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-U2 is untracked with 2 bins holding quantities (note the two bin names from its Edit Inventory Part dialog); QAPL-T1 is tracked with stock (for comparison). At Staging Heavy Duty: an open estimate, an open work order, an open part sale and the open purchase order.
custom_steps:
1. Estimate > a line > Add Part: type "QAPL-U2".
  2. In the same field type "QAPL-T1".
  3. Work order > a line > Add Part: type "QAPL-U2".
  4. Part sale > Add Part: type "QAPL-U2".
  5. Purchase order > Add item, part field: type "QAPL-U2".
custom_expected:
1. The QAPL-U2 option reads "Not Tracked" in place of "Inventory Qty: {n}", and its two bin chips still show as a shelf reference.
  2. The QAPL-T1 option shows "Inventory Qty: {n}" with its bin chips, as before.
  3. Same as step 1: "Not Tracked" with both bin chips.
  4. Same as step 1: "Not Tracked" with both bin chips.
  5. Same as step 1: "Not Tracked" with both bin chips.
